description_expanded: Nestled in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach along scenic 30A, this inviting 4-bedroom, 3-bath coastal retreat comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests and blends laid-back charm with the luxury of a private pool. Even better, it’s pet-friendly—welcoming small dogs—so your four-legged family members can join the fun. With generously sized front and back yards framed by palms and native greenery, there’s plenty of room for everyone to spread out and enjoy the coastal breeze. Just moments from the Gulf’s sugar-white sand and emerald waters, the home offers the perfect balance of privacy and convenience. Inside Turquoise Turtle Cottage , the living spaces feel bright, open, and effortlessly welcoming. The first-floor living room is filled with natural light and opens directly to the patio and pool area, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor flow that keeps everyone connected from morning coffee to evening conversations. Comfortable seating invites movie nights or relaxed evenings after a sun-soaked beach day. The kitchen is both stylish and functional, featuring granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and bar seating that encourages easy conversation while meals come together. The adjacent dining area provides a warm gathering place for everything from casual breakfasts to fresh Gulf seafood dinners. Also on this level, a guest bedroom with a queen bed and twin-over-twin bunk enjoys patio access, offering a flexible and family-friendly retreat. A hall bath with a walk-in shower and a convenient laundry room complete the thoughtfully designed first floor. Upstairs, the King Primary bedroom offers a serene escape with private balcony access—ideal for quiet mornings or unwinding beneath coastal skies. Its en suite bath includes a tub/shower combination for added comfort. Just down the hall, the bunk room features full-over-full bunks and its own tub/shower combo bath, creating a comfortable haven for kids or teens to recharge. Soft coastal tones and abundant natural light throughout the home enhance its relaxed, welcoming atmosphere. One of the true highlights of this location is its place in beloved Blue Mountain Beach, one of 30A’s most cherished communities. The beach is just an approximate 3–4 minute walk away with no major roads to cross, making spontaneous Gulf strolls part of your daily routine. You’re also just steps from Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for a post-dinner scoop, plus live music and lively cocktails at Red Fish Taco . A short bike ride or drive brings you to local favorites like Cowgirl Kitchen and For the Health of It, along with scenic bike paths and charming coastal boutiques. Explore nearby Grayton Beach and Seaside to the east for their vibrant town centers, or head west toward the quieter stretches of Dune Allen and the shopping and dining of Miramar Beach. Whether you’re traveling with family, friends, or your pup, this Blue Mountain Beach retreat delivers the very best of life along 30A. First Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Queen Sleeper Sofa, Kitchen, Dining, Guest Bedroom with Twin Bunk and Queen Bed + Patio Access, Hall Bath with Walk-In Shower, Laundry. Second Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo and Balcony Access, Bunk Room with Full Bunks and Tub/Shower Combo.
